_README: CURRENT data for v3/v4: see the "v4" block (four Yahoo/yfinance files, SHA-256). The "sources" and "tail_source" blocks describe the HISTORICAL v1/v2 pipeline (mixed GitHub archives + IBKR tail) and are NOT used by v4.
data_statement: Public archived OHLC files supplemented by IBKR daily bars as of 2026-11-12. Monthly audit snapshots ship in data/results; primary historical OHLC must be downloaded from upstream owners. Raw SPY/SPXL prices are not identically dividend-adjusted to adjusted QQQ/TQQQ: read LIMITATIONS.md.

SPY.format: Yahoo Finance unadjusted OHLC with Adj Close

SPXL.format: Yahoo Finance unadjusted OHLC with Adj Close

tail_source.provider: Interactive Brokers historical OHLC daily API
tail_source.window: from source's last archive date to 2026-11-12
tail_source.note: The audit used IBKR daily opens/closes. Licensed IBKR tails are kept locally and excluded from the public GitHub ZIP; replicate the recent tail with yfinance, accepting possible revision differences. Month-end NAV derived from audited dataset is included.

raw_data_license: Source archives were not relicensed by this repository. Verify rights and upstream terms before redistributing full OHLC files. These data are fetched locally and are gitignored.

revision_v2.status: Revised code and monthly risk bootstrap validated. Corrected daily metrics PENDING source refresh

risk_free.timing: At all sessions in calendar month m, use latest available quote at prior month-end m-1

revision_v2.must_verify: One bp source splice, common dividend-adjusted OHLC, external NAV total return for the funds

v3.vendor: Yahoo Finance daily bars exported by yfinance (auto_adjust=False), obtained from github.com/hjyssg/tqqq_simulation
v3.note: v3 uses only these four files; the v1/v2 archive+tail sources below are retained for history and are not used by scripts/v3_run.py. Raw files are not redistributed.

v4.note: Same four vendor files as v3 (hashes identical); provenance in data/v4_results/data_manifest.csv
v4.download_timestamp: not recorded upstream; last bar 2026-08-06, so download >= 2026-08-06 close; files received by the author 2026-11-12. scripts/fetch_yahoo.py records the UTC timestamp on any re-download.
